lessons_learned.issue: ProcessNewBlock function call had incorrect signature with 5 arguments instead of 4
lessons_learned.solution: Fixed ProcessNewBlock calls by using the correct signature: ProcessNewBlock(const std::shared_ptr<const CBlock>& block, bool force_processing, bool min_pow_checked, bool* new_block). Also needed to wrap CBlock in std::make_shared<CBlock>() and remove the BlockValidationState parameter.
lessons_learned.error_pattern: too many arguments to function call, expected 4, have 5

lessons_learned.issue: CheckProofOfWork function was not declared because pow.h was not included
lessons_learned.solution: Added #include <pow.h> to make CheckProofOfWork function available

notes: Bitcoin uses Nakamoto consensus (PoW-based probabilistic BFT)
Fault tolerance: < 50% of total hashpower can be adversarial
Consensus-critical code: src/consensus/ (rules), src/pow.cpp (PoW), src/validation.cpp (block/tx validation), src/script/ (script interpreter)
Test fixtures: BasicTestingSetup -> ChainTestingSetup -> TestingSetup -> TestChain100Setup
TestChain100Setup provides 100 pre-mined blocks with spendable coinbase via m_coinbase_txns
Block validation pipeline: CheckBlock() -> AcceptBlock() -> ConnectBlock()
UTXO model: transactions consume UTXOs (inputs) and create new UTXOs (outputs)
Script validation uses a stack-based interpreter in src/script/interpreter.cpp
Use regtest (ChainType::REGTEST) for testing: allows instant mining with minimal difficulty
